title: Virtual-knot problem 21 — Non-Commutativity and Long Knots
statement:
Non-Commutativity and Long Knots: It is known that any
classical long knot commutes with any long knot. This is definitely
not the case in the virtual category, see paper by Kamadas, Fenn et
al. However the commutativity of classical long knots may be
incorporated into the commutativity of virtual knots if the
following question is true. Is it true that if $K$ and $K'$ are long
knots and $K{\#} K'$ is isotopic to $K'{\#} K$ then there exists a
virtual long knot $L$, classical long knots $Q,\,Q'$, and
non-negative integer numbers $m,n$ such that
$$
K=L^{m} {\#} Q, \quad K'=L^{n} {\#} Q',
$$
where by $L^{m}$ we mean the connected sum of $m$ copies of the same
knot?
